name: Iced Matcha Latte
steps: Sift matcha powder into a small bowl.
Add hot water and whisk until smooth and frothy.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour in milk.
Pour matcha concentrate over the milk.
Stir gently and enjoy!

name: Dalgona Coffee
steps: Combine instant coffee, sugar, and hot water in a bowl.
Whip with a hand mixer or whisk until thick and fluffy.
Fill a glass with ice and milk.
Spoon the whipped coffee on top.
Stir before drinking. Enjoy!

name: Espresso Tonic
steps: Fill a glass with ice.
Pour in cold tonic water.
Slowly pour espresso over the top.
Add a lemon slice if desired.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

name: Brown Sugar Shaken Espresso
steps: Brew espresso and let cool slightly.
Add espresso and brown sugar syrup to a shaker with ice.
Shake well until chilled.
Pour into a glass over fresh ice.
Top with a splash of oat milk.
Stir and enjoy!

name: Lavender Latte
steps: Make espresso and set aside.
Heat milk and lavender syrup until warm.
Froth the milk (or shake with ice for iced latte).
Pour espresso into cup.
Add milk and stir gently.
Enjoy!

name: Strawberry Cold Foam Cold Brew
steps: Fill a glass with ice.
Pour in cold brew coffee.
In a separate container, combine heavy cream and strawberry syrup.
Froth until soft peaks form.
Spoon strawberry cold foam over the coffee.
Sip through the foam and enjoy!

name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee
steps: Add condensed milk to the bottom of a glass.
Place a Vietnamese phin filter on top.
Add ground coffee and press gently.
Pour hot water and let drip slowly.
Once fully dripped, fill glass with ice.
Stir vigorously and enjoy!

name: Hojicha Latte
steps: Whisk hojicha powder with hot water until smooth.
Steam or heat milk until warm and frothy.
Pour hojicha into a mug.
Add steamed milk and stir.
Sweeten to taste.
Enjoy the roasted, nutty flavor!
